notes.en: 166+ SPD at stage 10+ — 156 works if paired with a Healer granting +10 passive speed at 6★ transcendence.

{I-A/Unholy Exsultet} with ATK% main stat for bigger shields; prioritize ATK and SPD substats, with enough Effectiveness to land debuffs (use the +Effectiveness geas rather than an Effectiveness accessory).

p.en: Sacrifice options — use a {C/Mage} to tank the stun; the others can hold charms:

ul.en: {P/Liselotte}: +10 SPD and damage reduction while shielded (her EE); can hold {I-A/Starlight Road}. Best option for this slot thanks to her EE — {P/Demiurge Delta}, {P/Dianne}, {P/Mene} and {P/Viella} also work.
{P/Christina}: -30% damage reduction, holding a T4 {I-A/Charmer's Golden Chalice} — drop it if Ember doesn't fall below 50% HP on turn 1.
{P/Kuro}: tanks the stun, resets the boss's action bar on turn 1 and self-revives, so Ember only needs to tank her S3 before her shield is up (268+ Effectiveness).
{P/Ritri}, {P/Demiurge Drakhan} and {P/Omega Nadja}: damage reduction, can hold {I-A/Charmer's Golden Chalice} ({P/Omega Nadja} also lands Irregular Infection on turn 1 for a damage debuff).

p.en: Remove geas 15 (Ally Max HP -30%) for better survivability.
p.jp: ギアス15（味方の最大HP-30%）を外すと生存率が上がります。
p.kr: 기어스 15(아군 최대 체력 -30%)를 제거하면 생존율이 높아집니다.
p.zh: 移除契约15（友军最大生命值-30%）可提高生存率。
p.fr: Retirez le geas 15 (HP max alliés -30%) pour une meilleure survie.

notes.en: Can use a slower build with EE+10 to chain skill earlier and boost team AP.
Uses {I-W/Phantasm Necrosis} to lower her speed.

p.en: Break the boss on turn 15 before he uses enrage ultimate. Only remove geas 15 (Ally Max HP -30%) or use {P/Omega Nadja} if necessary for survivability.
p.jp: ターン15で怒りのアルティメットを使う前にボスをブレイクしてください。生存のためにギアス15（味方の最大HP-30%）を外すか、{P/Omega Nadja}を使用してください。
p.kr: 턴 15에서 분노 궁극기를 사용하기 전에 보스를 브레이크하세요. 생존을 위해 기어스 15(아군 최대 체력 -30%)를 제거하거나 {P/Omega Nadja}를 사용하세요.
p.zh: 在第15回合狂暴大招前打破Boss。为了生存可以移除契约15（友军最大生命值-30%）或使用{P/Omega Nadja}。
p.fr: Brisez le Boss au tour 15 avant qu'il n'utilise son ultime d'enrage. Ne retirez le geas 15 (HP max alliés -30%) ou n'utilisez {P/Omega Nadja} qu'en cas de nécessité pour la survie.

p.en: Replace {P/Core Fusion Veronica} with {P/Omega Nadja} for better turn 1 survivability (use min speed, hoping for speed debuff proc). If using {P/Omega Nadja}, disable the counter geas. Regular {P/Veronica} also works.
p.jp: {P/Core Fusion Veronica}を{P/Omega Nadja}に置き換えるとターン1の生存率が上がります（最低速度で速度デバフを期待）。{P/Omega Nadja}使用時はカウンターギアスを無効に。通常の{P/Veronica}でも可。
p.kr: {P/Core Fusion Veronica}를 {P/Omega Nadja}로 교체하면 턴 1 생존율이 높아집니다(최저 속도로 속도 디버프 기대). {P/Omega Nadja} 사용 시 카운터 기어스를 비활성화하세요. 일반 {P/Veronica}도 가능합니다.
p.zh: 将{P/Core Fusion Veronica}替换为{P/Omega Nadja}可提高第1回合生存率（最低速度期待速度减益触发）。使用{P/Omega Nadja}时禁用反击契约。普通{P/Veronica}也可以。
p.fr: Remplacez {P/Core Fusion Veronica} par {P/Omega Nadja} pour une meilleure survie au tour 1 (utilisez la vitesse minimale, en espérant le proc du debuff de vitesse). Si vous utilisez {P/Omega Nadja}, désactivez le geas de contre-attaque. La {P/Veronica} classique fonctionne aussi.

p.en: Designed for especially high-level stages (20+) over the previous team, where {P/Core Fusion Veronica} doesn't provide enough damage reduction to keep the team alive — especially if the boss crits someone on turn 1.
The -30% Max HP geas is turned OFF here, but you can turn it on if all your units survive a turn-1 crit, or to gamble for more points (the boss crit rate is 10%, but it feels much lower).
